description: Every 15 minutes on weekdays, reads new Gmail messages with attachments in the labels chosen in setup (Inbox, or a label such as AP Bills), has AI read each PDF or photo attachment, keeps the PDF as a workspace file, works out which client the bill is for, and adds one AP bill row per supplier tax invoice. Each new row starts an Enter a supplier bill job. It never changes the mailbox.
